description: This file is a Node.js script that inspects browser dependencies and missing libraries for browsers managed by Playwright, including mapping missing libraries to system packages, and resolving ambiguities interactively.

methods.name: pickPackage
methods.description: Selects the most appropriate package for a given library from a list, filtering out debug, test, dev, and mesa packages, and matching by prefix.

methods.name: findPackages
methods.description: Searches for system packages that provide a specific library using 'apt-file'.

methods.name: fileDependencies
methods.description: Retrieves shared library dependencies of a file using 'ldd'.

methods.name: missingFileDependencies
methods.description: Filters dependencies that are missing (not found) from the list of file dependencies.

methods.name: lddAsync
methods.description: Runs 'ldd' on a file with an adjusted LD_LIBRARY_PATH to include parent directories.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes a system command with arguments, returning stdout, stderr, and exit code.

methods.name: getDistributionName
methods.description: Reads '/etc/os-release' to determine the Linux distribution's pretty name.

methods.name: currentTime
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as 'Month Day, Year'.
